rationale.conceptual: The task applies a standard computational protocol (Nørskov-type free-energy diagram) with a minor surface modification (S-adsorbed Cu). The underlying theory and implementation steps are textbook methods from computational catalysis, requiring no custom algorithm derivation or deep domain-specific innovation.
rationale.execution: The workflow involves multiple stages: surface model generation, separate DFT geometry optimizations for ~5 adsorbates on two surfaces, convergence checks, and post-processing to compute Gibbs free energies. While each step is standard, the need to correctly set up plane-wave DFT calculations, handle pseudopotentials, and ensure consistent corrections qualifies as a moderate multi-stage pipeline.
